commands.checks: Bind the quoted COMPLEX.md statements and PR4088's free-word semantics; |O(n,2)|=|Sp(n-1,2)| for n=1,3,5 (n=7 with --full); the X_delta defect identity on all of O(3,2), O(5,2) and on random O(73,2) elements; H0=((1-i)/2)DCD exactly; depth recursion, halving and row-stock padding; the arbitrary-f lift of all four literal PR4088 words with monomial i^a generators, f=1,2,3, forward and dual.

Rejecting controls: non-orthogonal g and delta=0 fail the defect identity; the padded row range exceeds q bits; reading scalar signs as phase symbols or using non-inverse G^-1 breaks the lift; the lift passes at f=1 in the dual orientation.

Bind the four canonical words to the literal input words (B position, G columns, frame spans); every native warp edge class T_E K_G^(+-1) T_U^-1 (720 classes) is a Z4-monomial matrix, global phase included; controls: plain permutation P_G and swapped frames fail.
